problem.text: A review can be stale, self-approved or orphaned while notifications suggest the work is finished.
problem.evidence_state: Source requirement synthesis; no user research observation claimed

capability_outcome: Version-bound independent review, return/correction and scoped coordination move work to an evidenced outcome.
primary_parent: Existing primary epic retained for every child; cross-epic links are related contributions
excluded_scope_and_handoffs: Approve exact source versions; hand approved results to calculations/reporting; notification intent or delegated role never proves eligible independent approval.
shared_contract: Author/reviewer person identity, candidate revision, decision/return history, orphan escalation, mention permissions and actual notification delivery.

riskiest_assumption.hypothesis: Returned or reassigned work reaches an eligible natural person and only the reviewed current revision becomes approved.
riskiest_assumption.counter_hypothesis: The proposed capability does not produce the stated outcome or its controls cannot preserve the declared boundary.
riskiest_assumption.rank_rationale: Recommended highest-consequence uncertainty in this capability; priority not approved and no numerical risk score fabricated.
riskiest_assumption.method: Recommended isolated synthetic walkthrough of one source-positive case and its strongest source refusal; later representative user/operator evaluation requires an actually authorised purpose/population.
riskiest_assumption.population: No real participant cohort recruited or authorised by this proposal; source personas are planning roles.
riskiest_assumption.decision_rule: Any prohibited disclosure, data loss, independence bypass or wrong official result stops the affected commitment. If source checks succeed, assess the stated outcome in the authorised walkthrough; change the scope or method if the outcome is not demonstrated. This is a proposed qualitative rule, not an observed result or approved success threshold.
riskiest_assumption.actual_observation: Not run by this documentation refinement
riskiest_assumption.threshold_and_window: Existing source thresholds remain exact; any new user-outcome threshold/sample/window needs a recorded decision before it can support a commitment.

priority_rationale: Qualify independence, stale changes and review routing before collaboration conveniences or automation.

size.scope_unit: 10 active canonical child stories, inventory only; not effort or completion
size.method: Re-estimate selected bounded children using actual engineers and then-current contract/components; do not sum unset points into an invented epic duration.
variance_drivers: Confirm stage/quorum/threshold semantics, eligible reviewer rules and how mandatory privacy/security decisions combine with parallel stages.
Choose which running instances can migrate and what decisions must be invalidated/restarted.
Confirm evidence-pin/freshness invalidation rules when underlying material changes during an open review.
Choose reviewer edit UX: explicit return-to-draft/new authored candidate rather than silently altering approved context.
Confirm actionable-comment structure and final-disposition policy for each object type.
Decide whether any unchanged stages can be explicitly revalidated; default fresh decision sequence remains required.
Confirm which quality rules are mandatory blockers and who may approve proposed obligation exclusions.
Choose plain-language separation between live late records and locked official views.
Confirm correction-notice audience/delivery and which annual aggregation versions become the approved default.
Choose whether the existing seven-day runtime window remains the product limit or a separately reviewed configuration.
Confirm acting-capacity/delegation/emergency evidence fields and who may export decision history.
Any legal electronic-signature integration requires separate qualified contract/owner decision; ordinary approvals remain product decisions.
Which eligible backup/manager and delegation expiry policy should each review route use when reviewers depart?
Which moderation retention and mention eligibility rules apply to object-version threads and restricted field references?
Which permitted digest/channel options and mandatory security classes follow FD12, and who owns failed-contact remediation?
Which bounded actions/loop-depth/frequency limits and disable/checkpoint semantics are permitted for each automation trigger?
size.reestimate_trigger: Scope/control/data-boundary, dependency or selected-child revision changes

FR-WFL-001.rationale: Current natural-person independence/authority must survive every stage.

FR-WFL-002.rationale: Concurrent change/retry behaviour must preserve decision atomicity.

FR-WFL-003.rationale: Any stage revalidation must be an explicit qualified workflow rule.

FR-WFL-007.rationale: Complete measurement/source obligations are required before close.
Blocking/warning rules must be explicit in close eligibility.

FR-WFL-008.rationale: A prior locked snapshot is required to restate.
Obsolete report notice/supersession semantics support correction communications.

FR-WFL-010.rationale: Signoff must use current eligible reviewer authority and exact revision.
Append-only attributable audit governs decision evidence.

FR-WFL-004.rationale: Reviewer departure invalidates existing assignments and needs attributable replacement.

FR-WFL-005.rationale: Mention notifications need logical identity and current-authority opening.

FR-WFL-006.rationale: Due obligations and reviewer absence feed named escalation work.

FR-WFL-009.rationale: Automation retry uses bounded logical action identity and current-authority execution.
